message: I love bringing my solar garden lights indoors when the power goes out. It’s a little habit that keeps our home feeling cozy and bright, even when the world outside goes dark. Plus, our family group chat lights up with funny messages and tips on how to stay entertained during the outage. What do you do to keep the good vibes going when the lights flicker off?
scene: a windowsill lined with solar garden lights brought indoors (just after cleanup, everything tidy)
